title: A camera or screen share encodes through the machine's hardware encoder when present and falls back to the OpenH264 download otherwise
proof_scope: encoder selection, the fake-MFT open/refusal/keyframe path, and the NV12/Annex B helpers, unit-level; the on-hardware record needs a machine with a hardware MFT
native_client_proof: the released client shows screen share and camera running on the machine's own hardware encoder, with the OpenH264 download as the fallback
